remarks: WALK TO COVE ISLAND BEACH/PARK!! First floor 1/2-bedroom unit with large level backyard on nice street. Enjoy the best of Stamford living in this classic apartment located just minutes from the beach, shopping, and major commuting routes. This home offers a comfortable layout in a nice location - perfect for anyone who values convenience and coastal charm. Laundry is on-site and accessible directly from this first-floor unit. Separate utilities from second floor apartment. Water and sewer usage are paid by the landlord. Two off street parking spaces for this unit! Walk public transportation.
